commits.message:
fix(collector): a retire that settles drops its session's record, because the renderer lets go of the document on every outcome (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.0iu) (#716)

* fix(collector): a retire that settles drops its session's record, because the renderer lets go of the document on every outcome (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.0iu)

The main renderer's retire drops the session's world state in a finally
after the view's teardown, so a teardown that throws no longer leaves the
document held. The collector then removes a retiring record once its
retire settles, answered or threw, and only from the retiring period that
retire began, so a late answer to an earlier retire cannot remove a record
that was revived and retired again.

* refactor(renderer): one retire arm keeps the retire's contract, which the interface states, and the collector reads nothing of how a retire ended (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.0iu)

* fix(renderer): a retire's contract names the document it drops, and the session's open failure goes before its view's teardown can throw (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.0iu)

* refactor(renderer): a retire drops the session's document first, in one action with its view's closing, so nothing it does can keep the document (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.0iu)
